what: A 50px ring (1px accent border, 2px backdrop blur), hidden by default, trails the cursor with a .4s delay. Over a photo link it turns on and grows from .2x to 1x in .3s, and when leaving it shrinks to .2x and turns off in .2s. Moving from link to link, it stays on and glides along. For pages with many film festival and exhibition photo cards. Not present on touch or narrow devices

options.ease: Curve — GSAP name, default power1.out (original TweenLite default curve)
options.--fx-ring: Border color (css variable), default accent at 80%
options.[data-fx-part=target]: Link that lights the rings (anywhere in the panel)
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: (If present) ring element — if absent, the part creates one at the panel edge

from.where: shared.js page-level [data-fx~=ring-link-stalker] — original #js-mousestalker (TweenLite.to .4 on every mousemove {x,y}, .js-imglink mouseenter fromTo .3 {scale:.2}→{autoAlpha:1, scale:1}, mouseleave .2 {autoAlpha:0, scale:.2}, only above 1024px)

note: The original changes the ring color per program category (data-theme) — the consuming side gives --fx-ring a different value per panel
